issues.title: Add user authentication, registration, and profile management
issues.body: Add user account support with sign-up, login, profile pages, and per-user account details. This should include fields for name, email, academic position, and persistence beyond memory.

issues.title: Add role-based admin/organizer/member access control
issues.body: Implement admin and organizer roles for site management, and restrict management actions to authorized users. Include role assignment and admin-only management panels.

issues.title: Add presentation/session scheduling and management
issues.body: Support scheduling, editing, and deleting presentations or sessions, with session metadata such as room, date, time, number of presentations, and presentation type.

issues.title: Add suggestion/wish system for talk proposals
issues.body: Allow users to suggest or wish for talks/papers that others can later adopt and schedule. Track wishes and support selecting a wish into a future presentation.

issues.title: Add file upload support for presentations
issues.body: Enable users to attach files (PDFs, slides) to presentations and configure allowed file types and max upload size.

issues.title: Add email notification, reminders, and mailing system
issues.body: Add SMTP-configured email notifications for session reminders, news digests, registration confirmations, and member notifications.

issues.title: Add scheduled automation support
issues.body: Add scheduled background jobs or cron-like automation for email delivery, reminders, backups, and automated assignments.

issues.title: Add archive/history browsing and admin content management
issues.body: Add viewable archives of past presentations, filtering by year, plus admin-managed news/posts, contact info, and site settings.
